notes.title: [DEV] Gear Authenticity - U.S. Marines
notes.notes:
[h3]Commitment to Historical Accuracy
[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/S4369AR.jpeg[/img]
In WAR OPERATION Full Contact [b]historical authenticity[/b] is above all.

This U.S. Marines character is an example of how our team is working and how all details has been meticulously researched and recreated to stay as true to reality as possible.

Inspired by real equipments used in Iraq war context, our goal is to immerse players in an experience [b]where every element tells a story[/b]. From helmets to weapons, we designed to reflect the reality of military warfare.

See more : [url=https://forum.waroperation.com/topic/21/dev-gear-authenticity-u-s-marines]https://forum.waroperation.com/topic/21/dev-gear-authenticity-u-s-marines[/url]

notes.title: [DEVLOG] Development Report (11/2024)
notes.notes:
Since the game’s public shutdown to transition from alpha to beta, we have undertaken a [b]massive overhaul[/b] of the game’s mechanics and visuals,[i] not to mention that we completely modified locomotion system as video published in our dev-media. [/i]

These updates were essential to ensure a smooth and immersive gameplay experience. The menu now features a sleek, modern interface with dynamic new features, including the[b] HQ[/b]. This central hub allows you to [b]customize your skin[/b], [b] your weapons[/b], and train, replacing the previous alpha menu and becoming a pivotal part of the game experience. 

[b]Weapon Customization[/b]: Not only has the weapon customization system been reintroduced, but it’s also been enhanced with additional mechanics to deliver a fresh and exciting experience: 
[list]
[*] A dynamic workbench 
[*] Level progression for each weapon, unlocking new equipment as you advance 
[*] “Factionization” of weapons 
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PJHjoNm.png[/img]
[i]Picture of the in-game beta Weapon Workbench[/i]

[b]Shooting System[/b]: We completely reworked the shooting system, optimizing the code for reliability even under high latency, with dynamic position recalculations. 

[b]Character Redesign[/b]: Characters have been entirely redesigned to meet modern gaming standards, with graphic and dynamic optimizations that provide enhanced resolution and smoother gameplay. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KW7OdG7.png[/img]
[i]HQ corridor - Lockers room[/i]

And there’s even more to come! A detailed list of modifications will be released soon. 

In the meantime, stay tuned, and don’t forget to wishlist the game to get the latest updates.

Longmire Studio.

notes.title: Game services shutdown
notes.notes:
Our last meeting in May regarding the future of the game made us make the decision to[b] temporarily close access to the game[/b] for its Beta release.

Therefore from [b]July 15, 2024[/b] it will no longer be possible to purchase the game. Those who own the game may have difficulty accessing it due to the Online Services being closed - you will then be prompted to contact support for having deferred access.

We currently do not have a date for the beta, but we anticipate an outcome for fall 2024.

The beta will include the essential elements that our players expect such as customization, voice chat, full implementation of the clan system, technical modification, optimization of game mechanics. We have already published our beta weapon showcase on the Discord.

Thank you for playing War Operation™: Full Contact and hope you will enjoy the Beta.

Longmire Studio.

notes.title: Development Report (05/2024)
notes.notes:
This May, we held a meeting with the development team to find out what players want and how we can bring them more options.

Key questions included character and weapon customization and the lobby system, as well as the FPS view requested by many players. 

Although last month our work focused on optimizing the game's graphics with foliage. We're also considering a programmatic overhaul of the game to clean up the code and make it more stable.

If you have any questions, don't hesitate to use the Steam discussion or Discord.

Thank you for playing WAR OPERATION™ Full Contact.

notes.title: Rescue mode is now out!
notes.notes:
The new multiplayer mode "[b]Rescue[/b]" is now online with the latest content update: 

In this original new multiplayer mode, you'll have to rescue and escort a multitude of important agents out of the combat zone with your team. But be careful! Your enemies have the same intention for different purposes, so protect them at all costs and avoid ambushes. 

The team that reaches the objective or achieves the most exfiltration will be victorious.

Be sure to relaunch the game and Steam to launch the update.


What's new? - Fixes and changelogs :
[list]
[*] New multiplayer mode: Rescue.
[*] Map expansion to Ishtar Hotel now encompassing both hotels: "Hotels".
[*] Slight bots improvement in-game. Added logic for Rescue mode.
[*] Additions of 6 interactive elevators, 2 large for Palestine Hotel and 4 standard for Ishtar Hotel for rooftop warfare experience.
[*] Fall damage implementation (obvious with the previous point).
[*] Addition of weapon drop on death, weapon swap and ammo grab possibility from drops.
[*] Snipers' max damage distance expanded.
[*] Fixed kill reticle remaining on screen after killstreaking.
[*] Minimap is now synced to late joining players.
[*] Optimized lobby logic.
[*] Additional map details added.
[*] Opening of new paths in Palestine Hotel.
[*] Addition of a few trees.
[/list]

Stay tuned by wishlisting the game or why not diving directly into the early access experience by playing WAR OPERATION™: Full Contact.

Don't forget to report any bug in Discussions or directly in our [url=]discord.waroperation.com[/url]
